text: ポケモン　たくさん　とれたかな？

structure.en: were you able to catch, I wonder?

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end turns the sentence into a soft 'I wonder'. とれたかな = 'I wonder if you managed to catch them'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: とれる is the 'can do' form of とる, here in the past. とれた = 'were able to catch'.
